title: Moon density expression
description: Essential: Correct final expression for the Moon's density in terms of given variables: ρ = 3πr³/(GT²R³).

title: Travel time expression
description: Essential: Correct final expression for the travel time from A to B in terms of given variables: t = ((R+r)/(4r))√((R+r)/(2r)) T.

title: Apply Kepler's third law
description: Important: Correctly applies Kepler's third law to relate the period of the elliptical orbit to its semi-major axis and the known circular orbit parameters.

title: Identify semi-major axis
description: Important: Correctly identifies the semi-major axis of the elliptical orbit (a = (R+r)/2) from the geometry of points A, O, and B.

title: Relate mass to orbit
description: Important: Derives the mass of the Moon (M) from the circular orbit parameters using Newton's law of gravitation and centripetal force.

title: Time as half period
description: Optional: Recognizes that the travel time from A to B is half the period of the full elliptical orbit.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Demonstrates or implies dimensional/unit consistency in the final expressions.

title: Incorrect geometric axis
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the semi-major axis (e.g., using r or R alone, or (R+r) without the 1/2 factor).

title: Misapplied Kepler's law
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies Kepler's third law (e.g., using r³/T² = R³/t² or mixing up circular and elliptical orbit parameters).
